simple.meaning: עָרַף (ʻâraph) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to break the neck ; hence (figuratively) to destroy.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 6 times across Exodus, Deuteronomy, Isaiah, Hosea, beginning at Exodus 13:13. Its contexts include birth, family line, firstborn, city.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to עָרַף (H6202).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: עָרַף (ʻâraph) / H6202 is traced through Exodus 13:13, Exodus 34:20, Deuteronomy 21:4, Deuteronomy 21:6 as a generated source-based concept entry.

definitions.full: H6202. araph [ עָרַף ] verb denominative break the neck of an animal; — Qal Perfect 2masculine singular suffix וַעֲרַפְתּוֺ consecutive Exod 13:13 ; 34:20 (JE), 3 plural אֶתהָֿעֶגְלָה וְעָֽרְפוּשָֿׁם consecutive Deut 21:4 ; Participle active כֶּלֶב עוֺרֵף Isa 66:3 ; passive הָעֲרוּפָה הָעֶגְלָה Deut 21:6 ; Imperfect 3masculine singular יַעֲרֹף Hosea 10:2 figurative of breaking down altars.
definitions.rootNote: a primitive root (identical with through the idea of slopping ); properly, to bend downward; but used only as a denominative from 6203 ,
